title: Patch: hand, deck and graveyard triggers read alike
notes: Animosity (S+ #89), Corpse Eater (Core #89) and Legacy: Corpse Eater (TG #56) print their trigger from where the card waits as "While this is in your <zone>: …", as every other such card does (R5038000, §6.2); their Chinese faces follow. Corpse Eater's two are wording only. Animosity's `card` number is marked `read: "handOrDeck"`, as catalog check infers from its new line, so a Buff or Nerf reaches it only in the hand or deck (R3888000), no longer while it resolves or lies in a graveyard it could be played from.

player.title: Hand, deck and graveyard triggers read alike
changes: A Buff or Nerf changes Animosity's exile count only while it is in your hand or deck, the only places that count is read.
text: Animosity now reads "While this is in your deck: When your exile has 5 cards, cast this."
Corpse Eater and Legacy: Corpse Eater now read "While this is in your hand: When a Unit dies, this gains its attack and health."
